name: touch-grass-bible
description: The bible app that keeps you grounded in the word while letting you into some functionality.
author: Justice Vellacott

scripts.capacitor:sync:after: npm run android:apply-generated-fixes && npm run capacitor:assets
scripts.dev:web: APP_TARGET=web node esbuild.config.mjs & npm run serve
scripts.build:bundle:web: npm run getdatafiles && APP_TARGET=web node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:bundle:electron: npm run getdatafiles && APP_TARGET=electron node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:bundle:capacitor: npm run getdatafiles && APP_TARGET=capacitor node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:web: mkdir -p ./dist && npm run build:bundle:web && cp src/web/* dist
scripts.build:web:secure: mkdir -p ./dist && npm run getdatafiles && ENABLE_EXTERNAL_PLUGINS=false APP_TARGET=web node esbuild.config.mjs production && cp src/web/{favicon.ico,icon-192.png,icon-512.png,manifest.json,service-worker.js} dist/
scripts.build:web:extensible: mkdir -p ./dist && npm run getdatafiles && ENABLE_EXTERNAL_PLUGINS=true APP_TARGET=web node esbuild.config.mjs production && cp src/web/{favicon.ico,icon-192.png,icon-512.png,manifest.json,service-worker.js} dist/
scripts.ai: bash -lc 'if ! command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Ollama CLI not found; skipping ai script."; exit 0; fi; node ./processing/filetochat.mjs || { echo "AI processing skipped (requires reachable Ollama models)."; exit 0; }'
scripts.build:electron: mkdir -p ./dist && npm run build:bundle:electron && cp ./src/electron/* ./dist && cp ./src/web/favicon.ico ./src/web/icon-512.png ./dist
scripts.run:electron: node -e "if(process.platform==='linux'&&!process.env.DISPLAY&&!process.env.WAYLAND_DISPLAY){console.log('No display server detected; skipping run:electron.'); process.exit(0);}" && npm run build:electron && cd dist && npm install && npm run start
scripts.package:electron: npm run build:electron && cd dist && npm install && npm run package
scripts.make:electron: npm run build:electron && cd dist && npm install && (npm run make || echo "Electron make skipped (requires full native packaging toolchain).")
scripts.run:embed: esbuild processing/embedding.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=processing/embedding.js && (node processing/embedding.js || echo "Embedding run skipped (requires Ollama with nomic-embed-text).") && rm -f processing/embedding.js
scripts.add:android: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml')){console.log('Android platform already present.'); process.exit(0);}" && npx cap add android
scripts.add:ios: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('ios/App/App.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj')){console.log('iOS platform already present.'); process.exit(0);}" && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync:capacitor: ./scripts/with-android-sdk.sh bash -lc 'mkdir -p ./dist && npm run build:bundle:capacitor && cp src/web/* dist && npx cap sync'
scripts.open:android: ./scripts/with-android-sdk.sh bash -lc 'if command -v studio >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx cap open android; else echo "Android Studio CLI not found; skipping open:android."; fi'
scripts.open:ios: bash -lc 'if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Darwin" ]; then echo "open:ios requires macOS; skipping."; exit 0; fi; npx cap open ios'
scripts.run:android: ./scripts/with-android-sdk.sh --require bash -lc 'npm run build:capacitor && (npx cap run android || echo "run:android skipped (no Android device/emulator detected).")'
scripts.run:ios: bash -lc 'if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Darwin" ]; then echo "run:ios requires macOS; skipping."; exit 0; fi; npm run build:capacitor && npx cap run ios'
